entries.description: in lahyaan inaash aruusaan ehel (min) abuurtaan
entries.subject: in lahyaan

spans.text: Mogolaayte iyo naagaayte baaluqeen, ishoonoo lasoon kale meerin dhinace dhalashade iyoo qowmiyade, waxa xaq in lahyaan inaash aruusaan ehel (min) abuurtaan.

entries.description: iska jin ka iyaan xaqe kasaabsanyee minke
entries.subject: iska jin

spans.text: Waxane iska jin ka iyaan xaqe kasaabsanyee minke,intiibo xariirakaas aruusaas soctee iyoo mariis dhamaadeebo.

entries.description: lamade doonaan inaash is aruusaan
entries.subject: lamade doonaan

spans.text: Guure waxa dhecee kare bes marii lahelee doonoo xur iyee lamade doonaan inaash is aruusaan.

entries.description: Dawladde Mujtamace sa badbaadishaan
entries.subject: Dawladde Mujtamace

spans.text: Ehele waxa iye bilaawe asal in iyee mujtamace, waxane xaq inlahyee in Dawladde Mujtamace sa badbaadishaan.

entries.description: lasuun fiirin ama lasuku reebin xuduud
entries.subject: lasuun fiirin

spans.text: Qofkastabo waxa xaq in lahyee inaas helee xurnimo dhinace ra’yide iyoo baaranke; waxa kale xaq in lahyee inaa lasuku farogelin ra’yidis iyoo inaas waydistee, helee, dhiibee baaran iyo fikir usoo isticmaalee qalab kasto oo baaran faafishoote iyee usoo lasuun fiirin ama lasuku reebin xuduud.

entries.task_id: toos iyee|ama|usoo si xurnimo iyee dadkale indooradee
entries.description: toos iyee ama usoo si xurnimo iyee dadkale indooradee
entries.subject: toos iyee
entries.object: usoo si xurnimo iyee dadkale indooradee

spans.text: Qofwalbo waxa xaq inlahyee inaas kaqeeb qaatee maamule dalis si toos iyee ama usoo si xurnimo iyee dadkale indooradee.

Doonoote shacbide iye asaase awoode Dowladde; Doonoote waxa laka muujishee kare doorasho run iyee oo waqti sax iyee laqabadee, laka wado qayb qaatee, waxane indhicideeyaan si qarsoodi iyee ama sikale oo wal laka doortee oo xur iyee.

entries.subject: us xubin

folded.object: jirte umul wal xaq inlahtee ishe iyo ilmadish xanaano iyo ogaansho khaas iyee ilmade dhamaantishon ha dhaltaan ama inka dhalan meher wal xaq inlahyan ogaasnho iska hal iye

spans.text: Ingade ka jirte umul wal xaq inlahtee ishe iyo ilmadish xanaano iyo ogaansho khaas iyee ilmade dhamaantishon ha dhaltaan ama inka dhalan meher wal xaq inlahyan ogaasnho iska hal iye.
Waxane iska jin ka iyaan xaqe kasaabsanyee minke,intiibo xariirakaas aruusaas soctee iyoo mariis dhamaadeebo.

folded.id: iyee lasoon|ka|badbaadishee wal kasto walii kala meroo iyee kaasoo ka horjeedee baaqakon ama dhiirigelishee karee kala mermeroo

folded.object: badbaadishee wal kasto walii kala meroo iyee kaasoo ka horjeedee Baaqakon ama dhiirigelishee karee kala mermeroo

spans.text: Dade oo dhan waxa xaq in lahyaan inaa si jin iyee lasoon ka badbaadishee wal kasto walii kala meroo iyee kaasoo ka horjeedee Baaqakon ama dhiirigelishee karee kala mermeroo.

folded.id: karo ciqaab|ka|adagtee tii in deqsanaay fale dembidakaas marii lageli
folded.subject: karo ciqaab
folded.object: adagtee tii in deqsanaay fale dembidakaas marii lageli

spans.text: Qofne mal susaaree karo ciqaab ka dhalati ficil ama ficilla’aan haddii ficilakaas amo ficilla’aantakaas dhinace sharcide belede amo kon Caalamide iyee, inaas ahaan dembi waqtide lageli.Sidaas ookale dembiilade mal susaaree karo ciqaab ka adagtee tii in deqsanaay fale dembidakaas marii lageli.

folded.id: karo ciqaab|ka|dhalati ficil ama ficilla’aan haddii ficilakaas amo ficilla’aantakaas dhinace sharcide belede amo kon caalamide iyee
folded.subject: karo ciqaab
folded.object: dhalati ficil ama ficilla’aan haddii ficilakaas amo ficilla’aantakaas dhinace sharcide belede amo kon Caalamide iyee

spans.text: Qofne mal susaaree karo ciqaab ka dhalati ficil ama ficilla’aan haddii ficilakaas amo ficilla’aantakaas dhinace sharcide belede amo kon Caalamide iyee, inaas ahaan dembi waqtide lageli.Sidaas ookale dembiilade mal susaaree karo ciqaab ka adagtee tii in deqsanaay fale dembidakaas marii lageli.
Guure waxa dhecee kare bes marii lahelee doonoo xur iyee lamade doonaan inaash is aruusaan.

Qofkastabo waxa xaq in lahyee inaas helee xurnimo dhinace ra’yide iyoo baaranke; waxa kale xaq in lahyee inaa lasuku farogelin ra’yidis iyoo inaas waydistee, helee, dhiibee baaran iyo fikir usoo isticmaalee qalab kasto oo baaran faafishoote iyee usoo lasuun fiirin ama lasuku reebin xuduud.

folded.id: maxkamaddane inaash|ka|dhawaaqtee dade soon furanyee oone eedeeysanadaayte lasoon aqbali damiinade daruuri in itee difaacishoon
folded.subject: Maxkamaddane inaash
folded.object: dhawaaqtee dade soon furanyee oone eedeeysanadaayte lasoon aqbali damiinade daruuri in itee difaacishoon

spans.text: Qofwalbo lusuku eedeeshee dacwo ciqaab itee waxa xaq inlahyee inlasuun maleeshee inaas iyee dembilaawe intii laka cadeedee inaas iyee dembiile side sharcide qabee, Maxkamaddane inaash ka dhawaaqtee dade soon furanyee oone eedeeysanadaayte lasoon aqbali damiinade daruuri in itee difaacishoon.

folded.id: maxkamo caadil|itee|hortishe marii lasugeedee xuquuqtis iyoo waajibaadis iyo marii dhecee in lasuun reebtee dacwo ciqaab itee
folded.subject: Maxkamo Caadil
folded.object: hortishe marii lasugeedee xuquuqtis iyoo waajibaadis iyo marii dhecee in lasuun reebtee dacwo ciqaab itee

spans.text: Qof kastabo waxa xaq inlahyee inaas helee iskajin biifanyee, Maxkamo Caadil itee hortishe marii lasugeedee xuquuqtis iyoo waajibaadis iyo marii dhecee in lasuun reebtee dacwo ciqaab itee.

folded.id: neebsade saacadaaanyo|ka|jiree shuqule iyo xilide fasaxe oo mushahar sun soctee
folded.subject: neebsade saacadaaanyo
folded.object: jiree shuqule iyo xilide fasaxe oo mushahar sun soctee

spans.text: Qofwalba wal xaq inlahye inaas neebsade saacadaaanyo ka jiree shuqule iyo xilide fasaxe oo mushahar sun soctee.

Qafwalbo waxa lahyee xuquuqte laka tilmaami Baaqakon ishoo liinkala meerin dhinace qabiile, midibe, nin ama naag,luqade, diinte, siyaasade am afikir kale, dhalashade ama meeltii ka asalmi, Maale, dhalashade ama xaaladaayno kaleento.
Majiro qof lasu adoonsadee karee, addoonsashade iyoo kan tijaarade addoonte reebanyan noociis doonee ka imaadee.

Qofwalba wal xaq inlahye inas nololtis ka gaaree heer wal tar in lahyee caafimaadis iyo raaxade ehelis inka horeeshe, Hunguride, labise, minke, daryeele caafimaad iyo wal kasto walii khidma bulsho iye liin baahanye wal kale xaq inlahye inas helee daryeel marii suku dhece shuqul la’aan Jiro, curyaanimo, dhimasho, duqnimo, ama musiibo kale us in awoodin inas shuqul qabte oo awoodis ka baxsantee.

Walkale lusuku sameen Karin kalameroo kafadhitee arimaayte siyaasade, xukun ama arincaalami oo us ka suganyee, dhule ama belede us indhalti, hanaqto bedeledas koo madobanaanyee, koo weli dowla kaleento su maamultee (dardaaran) koo in reeban xukun hooseeshee ama in reeban xurnimo biifanyee.

folded.id: simanyaan inaas|ka|qeeb gelaan maamule kor ee belede kajiree
folded.subject: simanyaan inaas
folded.object: qeeb gelaan maamule kor ee belede kajiree

spans.text: Dade dhammaantishoo inka simanyaan inaas ka qeeb gelaan maamule kor ee belede kajiree.
Qofkasto waxa xaq inlahyee inaas beledkale inwaydistee wane kahelee megengel siyaaso usoo ka rooridee cadaadishoo.

Qafwalbo waxa lahyee xuquuqte laka tilmaami Baaqakon ishoo liinkala meerin dhinace qabiile, midibe, nin ama naag,luqade, diinte, siyaasade am afikir kale, dhalashade ama meeltii ka asalmi, Maale, dhalashade ama xaaladaayno kaleento.

folded.id: toos iyee|ama|usoo si xurnimo iyee dadkale indooradee
folded.subject: toos iyee
folded.object: usoo si xurnimo iyee dadkale indooradee

spans.text: Qofwalbo waxa xaq inlahyee inaas kaqeeb qaatee maamule dalis si toos iyee ama usoo si xurnimo iyee dadkale indooradee.

Doonoote shacbide iye asaase awoode Dowladde; Doonoote waxa laka muujishee kare doorasho run iyee oo waqti sax iyee laqabadee, laka wado qayb qaatee, waxane indhicideeyaan si qarsoodi iyee ama sikale oo wal laka doortee oo xur iyee.

folded.id: urur amo|ka|biiree kuwoo suubsanyan si us in ilaalishe maslaxadis
folded.subject: urur amo
folded.object: biiree kuwoo suubsanyan si us in ilaalishe maslaxadis

spans.text: Qofwalba wal xaq inlahye ians suubishe urur amo ka biiree kuwoo suubsanyan si us in ilaalishe maslaxadis.

Qof walbo, maadaama us xubin ka iyee bulshade, wal xaq in lahye inas helee daryeel caafimaad.Daryeelas oo qofwalbo suun sahal leeyee xuquuq dhaqaale, mujtamac iyo koo tacliinte iyee oo muhiim in iyee qofe sharaftis, xornimadis iyo weenaatis Taasoo ka imaadeetee dadaale gude iyo iskaashide caalamide, usoo laka fiirideeye nidaame iyo dakhlide dawla kasta.
Qof kastabo waxa xaq inlahyee inaas kadhoofee beled kasto oo kajiree kiikis, wane ka soo naqtee kare.
